async def parse_list(page):
    items = await page.query_selector_all('ul li')
    for item in items:
        link = await item.query_selector('a[href*="/spiromics/"]')

            href = await link.get_attribute('href')
            yield response.follow(href, callback=parse_detail)

async def parse_detail(page):

code_snippets.parse_detail:
async def parse_detail(page):
    await page.wait_for_selector('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_TITLE')
    title = await page.text_content('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_TITLE')
    author = await page.text_content('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_AUTHOR')
    pdf_link = await page.get_attribute('a[href$=".pdf"]', 'href')
    # 下载文件示例
    if pdf_link:
        await page.goto(pdf_link)
    return {"title": title, "author": author, "pdf_link": pdf_link}

code_snippets.parse_list:
async def parse_list(page):
    items = await page.query_selector_all('ul li')
    results = []
    for item in items:
        title = await item.query_selector_eval('div.title, h3.title', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        author = await item.query_selector_eval('div.author, span.author', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        date = await item.query_selector_eval('div.date, span.date', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        pdf_link = await item.query_selector_eval('a[href$=".pdf"]', 'el => el.href').catch(lambda e: None)
        supp_link = await item.query_selector_eval('a.supplementary', 'el => el.href').catch(lambda e: None)
        results.append({
            'title': title,
            'author': author,
            'date': date,
            'pdf_link': pdf_link,
            'supplementary_link': supp_link
        })
    return results

code_snippets.parse_detail:
async def parse_detail(page):
    title = await page.text_content('h1.record-title')
    authors = await page.eval_on_selector_all('div.authors-list > span.author-name', 'nodes => nodes.map(n => n.textContent)')
    pub_date = await page.text_content('span.pub-date')
    abstract = await page.text_content('div.abstract-section > p')
    pdf_url = await page.get_attribute('a.download-pdf', 'href')
    supplementary_urls = await page.eval_on_selector_all('a.supplementary-download', 'nodes => nodes.map(n => n.href)')
    return {
        'title': title.strip(),
        'authors': authors,
        'publication_date': pub_date.strip(),
        'abstract': abstract.strip(),
        'pdf_url': pdf_url,
        'supplementary_materials': supplementary_urls
    }

async def parse_detail(page):

        'study_id': study_id.strip() if study_id else '',
        'status': status.strip() if status else '',
        'start_date': start_date.strip() if start_date else '',
